title: Rezoning to allow housing at 135-27 Sapphire Street, Queens
summary: This application changes the zoning map from an R4 to an R6A district for property at 135-27 Sapphire Street in Queens Community District 10. The change would allow construction of a new six-story residential building of about 186,380 square feet with roughly 268 apartments, including about 67 income-restricted units under Mandatory Inclusionary Housing. The City Planning Commission approved the application and the Council held a public hearing on September 23, 2026.
